name: AI-Assisted Software Development & Program Synthesis
summary: The fast-moving frontier where programs write programs: classic program synthesis, LLM coding assistants and agents, and how to evaluate and safely adopt them.

topics.name: Classic program synthesis: deductive, enumerative and example-based

Code completion and chat assistants in the IDE

Security, licensing and provenance of AI-generated code
AI for testing, program repair and program analysis
